sections.description: Selective WordPress push and pull migrations controlled from either site. Transfer selected database tables, plugins, themes and media using verified streams, with destination rollback and cascading media comparison.
sections.changelog:
0.1.12

  • Add agent-oriented CLI presets for database refreshes, missing plugins and version-controlled code pushes.
  • Add read-only selection plans, automatic Git folder discovery and structured workflow results.

0.1.11

  • Copy the source active plugin list by default for every push or pull, including partial transfers.
  • Add an explicit option to preserve destination activation, and restore previous activation during recovery.

0.1.10

  • Run staging and replacement from one Push or Pull action.
  • Retain three destination backups with a separate restore page.
  • Resume interrupted network transfers and recover failed replacements automatically.

0.1.9

  • Require matching Trickle versions before preparing, transferring or applying migrations.
  • Update remote Trickle from the controlling site through the configured JSON feed, with separate permission and package validation.

0.1.8

  • Protect Git working directories and always exclude environment files, Git metadata, .gitignore and node_modules.
  • Add incremental plugin/theme transfers, paginated file-change previews and pre-apply checks.
  • Resume checksummed 512 KB network segments using retained source streams.
  • Add temporary apply maintenance and automatic rollback on frontend HTTP 5xx.
  • Handle HTTP/HTTPS/protocol-relative and JSON-escaped URL replacements.
  • Add named, expiring, separately revocable connection keys.

0.1.7

  • Enable Plugin Update Checker with a static JSON feed, matching the Guest Key update method.
  • Register update checks in dashboard, cron, AJAX, REST and WP-CLI requests.
  • Use versioned GitHub release ZIPs and identify the custom update source to WordPress.

0.1.6

  • Add cached year, month and file comparisons for changed or missing media, with push, pull and rollback support.
